en: Black-and-white postcard image of a large Baroque/Neoclassical manor or palace with a central portico supported by columns, a triangular pediment with a clock or cartouche above it, and a long, symmetrical façade. The building is surrounded by trees and a landscaped drive and lawn in the foreground. The caption at the bottom left reads "Schloß Remten (Kurland)".
